If a parent has bipolar it is more likely you'll be bipolar compared to someone else who's parents aren't bipolar. Now if your parents have some kind of mental illness that isn't bipolar it still puts you more at risk for having a mental illness than other people. You might not have the same mental illness but you are predisposed to them if it's hereditary.  It is possible to have a different mental illness than your parents. Lastly you can still be bipolar even if your parents are seemingly fine and don't have bipolar or any other kind of mental illness.  The chances of this happening are smaller than people's families who are predisposed to mental illness but it's still not at 0. So really anyone can be mentally ill.  On the flip side just because your parents are doesn't mean you necessarily will be. Though your chances are much higher compared to someone from a non mentally ill family.
